motions.motion: adjourn the work session. The motion was

approve the Conceptual Plan for the Brookeshire Place Subdivision located at 5840 South Highland Drive subject to the following: Conditions: 1. Any preliminary plat application and/or plan [set] provided to the City for the Project shall incorporate the following corrections/revisions/comments or considerations [in no particular order] [as] made to/on the conceptual plat application and plan(s) by the Commission or Staff prior to and in conjunction with submitting to the City a subsequent application for preliminary plat review and approval. a. Revise reported lot areas to reflect actual square feet vs. representing they are 6,250+; and, b. Revise great circle diameters on each lot to 50’ vs 65’ shown; and, c. Verify that the net buildable area reported in the tabulation table on the plat face subtracts land to be dedicated, the portion of the private lane that crosses Lot 1, and the fire department turnaround leg that (and arc areas) that traverses over building Lots 2 and 3. That is, only the straight, 20- foot wide, lane section that traverses Lots 2 & 3 must be subtracted from Project gross buildable area (After also discounting any dedicated land) and their respective, reported sizes. 2. Any other conditions as may be imposed by the Commission. 3. Will Serve Letters shall be provided from applicable utilities
final site plan approval for the Fairfield Hotel Project come back to the Planning Commission

motions.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission.
